ai.title: Developing countries should adapt to AI tools before racing to build own model: World Bank
ai.description: The World Development Report 2026, titled 'The Promise of Artificial Intelligence', said developing countries should first adopt existing AI tools and adapt to them for local needs before advancing to build their own frontier models.
ai.title_cn: 世界银行：发展中国家在竞相建立自己的模型之前应适应人工智能工具
ai.description_cn: 题为《人工智能的承诺》的《2026年世界发展报告》表示，发展中国家应首先采用现有的人工智能工具并根据当地需求进行调整，然后再推进建立自己的前沿模型。

ai.title: Paul Graham says Amazon’s AI agent restrictions could open door for startup rival
ai.description: Amazon’s restrictions on artificial intelligence (AI) shopping agents could create an opening for startups to build a new rival to the e-commerce giant, as consumers increasingly look towards autonomous AI tools to search for and purchase products, Y Combinator co-founder Paul Graham said.
ai.title_cn: 保罗·格雷厄姆表示亚马逊的人工智能代理限制可能会为初创公司竞争对手打开大门
ai.description_cn: Y Combinator联合创始人保罗·格雷厄姆（Paul Graham）表示，亚马逊对人工智能（AI）购物代理的限制可能会为初创公司打造这家电子商务巨头的新竞争对手创造机会，因为消费者越来越多地寻求自主人工智能工具来搜索和购买产品。

ai.title: Dear AI - so how, exactly, are you going to kill us?
ai.description: With so much concern over the surge of artificial intelligence, it seems worth inquiring about the specifics of our looming destruction.
ai.title_cn: 亲爱的人工智能--那么你到底要如何杀死我们呢？
ai.description_cn: 由于人们对人工智能的激增如此担忧，似乎有必要询问我们即将到来的毁灭的具体情况。

ai.title: Michael Burry: Anthropic’s valuation equals 78 S&P 500 companies
ai.description: Michael Burry compares Anthropic’s massive valuation with 78 profitable S&P 500 companies, raising concerns about soaring artificial intelligence valuations. The Big Short investor also warns about AI infrastructure spending, market risks and potential losses if the economics of artificial intelligence change, while drawing comparisons with valuations seen before the dot-com crash.
ai.title_cn: Michael Burry：Anthropic的估值相当于78家标准普尔500公司
ai.description_cn: 迈克尔·伯里（Michael Burry）将Anthropic的巨额估值与78家盈利的标准普尔500指数公司进行了比较，引发了人们对人工智能估值飙升的担忧。这位大空头投资者还对人工智能基础设施支出、市场风险和潜在损失发出警告，同时与互联网崩盘前的估值进行了比较。
